title: Penthouse Magazine July 2006 Music Issue Complete w/ Centerfold Ice Cube Chuck D
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no visible creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 2006 Music Issue. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: ForePLAYLIST - 25 songs; Superman Returns director Bryan Singer; Hottest Summer Tours; Avenged Sevenfold; Ice Cube, Chuck D and The Streets; 15 Best New Rap Stars.

Back cover: JVC car stereo ad featuring the band Disturbed.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
